items.t: FLY ONE ROUNDTRIP WITH SOUTHWEST AIRLINES OVER THE HOLIDAYS AND EARN A PROMOTIONAL COMPANION PASS
items.sum: Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE: LUV) is rewarding Customers who travel this season with a limited-time Black Friday offer that gives Rapid Rewards® Members the opportunity to earn a promotional Companion Pass® after completing one qualifying roundtrip flight or two qualifying one-way flights for travel between November 27, 2026, and January 5, 2027.1

items.t: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Southwest Airlines, American Airlines and Copa
items.sum: Southwest Airlines, American Airlines and Copa Holdings show resilience despite rising fuel and labor costs and ground stop-related disruptions.

items.t: Southwest Airlines makes major change to its flight schedules
items.sum: The low-cost airline is reworking how passengers can book flights.

items.t: H-E-B, Southwest, Dell lead Forbes' best Texas companies list
items.sum: H-E-B beat out Southwest, Dell and ExxonMobil to top Forbes’ new list of the best companies based in Texas. Tesla squeaked in at No. 25.

items.t: Alaska Air EPS Estimates Southbound: Should You Avoid the Stock?
items.sum: ALK faces declining earnings estimates, soaring fuel costs and mounting financial pressures, making the stock a risky bet despite its cheap valuation.

items.t: Kyndryl and Hermes International have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
items.sum: Kyndryl's rising earnings estimates and attractive valuation fuel upside hopes, while Hermes faces slowing sales growth and mounting earnings pressure.
